note: Banco Popular de Puerto Rico's credit card agreements, one per card, each read in full on 30 October 2026 as its card agreements page links them: Visa Cash Rewards, Visa PREMIA® Rewards, AAdvantage® Visa Signature Plus, JetBlue Mastercard, JetBlue Mastercard Eleva, Visa Cobalt Infinite and Visa Infinite (the last on the agreements page, though no longer among the cards its credit cards page offers new applicants). Each card's purchase rate is 16.99% to 29.99% a year by creditworthiness (the Prime Rate plus a margin), written as that range; its cash advance rate 27.99% to 31.99%, written so. The cards that open at 1.99% a year for their first six months carry that as their introductory rate (Visa Cobalt Infinite and Visa Infinite have none); the 0% balance transfer offer isn't written, balance transfers not being modelled. Each card's annual fee is as its agreement states (none where it says $0). The cash advance and convenience check fee is 2% of each transaction, at least $2 and at most $10. The foreign transaction fee is 1% on the two Visa reward cards, 1.4% on the JetBlue Mastercard, and none on the others (written as 0). The minimum payment is 2% of the balance or the interest plus $10 or $29, whichever is higher (the whole balance when it's under $29): written as 2% with a $29 floor; the interest-plus-$10 alternative, the higher one when the month's interest and $10 together pass 2% of the balance, isn't modelled.The late fee is 'up to $40' (and never more than the minimum payment due) and the returned payment fee 'up to $10', each written at its stated top. The due date is at least 21 days after each statement closes, and purchases go without interest when the full balance is paid by it: no longest grace is stated, so none is written. The agreements state no penalty rate and no over-limit fee. The main banks: Popular, FirstBank and Oriental, Puerto Rico's three largest banks. FirstBank's site (1firstbank.com) sits behind an Incapsula bot check and wasn't read, and Oriental's card page links disclosures that answer 404 (30 October 2026); both banks' terms were read instead from the copies they filed in the CFPB's credit card agreement database (its Q2 2026 submissions), the federal register card issuers must file with. FirstBank's application disclosures for its Beyond One, Beyond Platinum (each a Visa and a Mastercard), Beyond Global (a Visa) and Beyond Ultimate (a Visa and a Mastercard): a purchase rate of 16.75% to 29.00% a year by creditworthiness, written as that range; a cash advance rate of 25.25% to 30.25%; a 29.99% penalty rate once a minimum payment is 60 days unpaid (the 60 days and the six on-time payments that end it aren't modelled); 1.99% for the first six months on the One and Platinum, 0% for the first 15 months on the Global and Ultimate (for purchases made in the first six months), written as their introductory rates; no annual fee on the One and Platinum, $50 on the Global and $150 on the Ultimate after a first 12 months free; a cash advance fee of 2% ($2 to $10); a foreign transaction fee of 1% on Visa and 1.4% on Mastercard; a late fee 'up to $35' (no more than $25 for a first late payment in six months, which isn't modelled) and a returned check fee 'up to $10', written at their tops. FirstBank's agreement sets the minimum payment at 2% of the balance or $15, whichever is greater, plus the finance charges. Its Beyond Business Mastercard isn't written. Oriental's disclosures for the three cards its credit cards page offers, the Mastercard Puntos, Mastercard Standard and Mastercard Secured: purchase rates of 14.95% to 24.95% (Puntos), 14.95% to 23.95% (Standard) and 19.95% (Secured, which needs a deposit of at least $500, a condition the game doesn't check), each after 1.99% for its first six months; 27.99% on cash advances; a 29.99% penalty rate after a late payment; $25 a year on the Puntos after a free first year, nothing on the others; a cash advance fee of 2% ($2 to $10); 1% on foreign transactions; a late fee 'up to $35', written at its top; a $10 returned check fee. Oriental's revolving accounts agreement (from its site) sets the minimum payment at 2% of the balance or $15, whichever is greater (3% while the penalty rate applies, not modelled). The database's other Oriental disclosures (a plain 'MasterCard' and an 'Oriental Master Card' at 18%) aren't among the cards it offers, and aren't written. This file kept Popular's Visa Cash Rewards, read on 29 October 2026, and adds its terms in full.
